articles.title: These reborn Red Sox are magical, but the old-school skeptic keeps screaming there’s a catch to this run
articles.description: It’s harder and harder by the day to doubt this team, but does all this juju and voodoo carry an inevitable expiration date?

articles.title: Some Red Sox players have taken the hobby of card collecting to the next level: ‘It’s a rush’
articles.description: It’s been common for the team to arrive with multiple cars filled with players to descend en masse on shops.

articles.title: ‘Mickey Jones’ has stepped in nicely for the Red Sox since Masataka Yoshida went on the injured list
articles.description: Mickey Gasper and Jahmai Jones were 12 for 23 with nine extra-base hits and 12 RBIs over the eight games after Yoshida strained his left hamstring on Aug. 15.

articles.title: Red Sox listless, sloppy while getting shut out by the Marlins
articles.description: The Sox had 18 ground-ball outs, and Miami pitchers retired nine of the final 10 batters. By any measure, it was one of their worst games of the season.

articles.title: Game 133: Red Sox go for sweep of Marlins
articles.description: Sonny Gray will be on the mound in Miami when the Red Sox look to extend their winning streak to six games.

articles.title: Roman Anthony, Trevor Story think they’ll be with Red Sox this weekend for Yankees series
articles.description: The pair, continuing rehab assignments with Triple-A Worcester, hope to rejoin big club on the road for four games in New York.

articles.title: ‘It was stressful, to be honest’: Jarren Duran delivers with 11th-inning grand slam to lift Red Sox over Marlins
articles.description: Mickey Gasper added two solo home runs as Boston, on a five-game win streak, improved to a season-high 14 games above .500.

articles.title: Injured players soon to return to Red Sox aren’t guaranteed lineup spot, Chad Tracy says
articles.description: Roman Anthony, Isiah Kiner-Falefa, and Trevor Story are close, but the club has performed well in their absence.

articles.title: Kalshi bets on partnership with the Red Sox
articles.description: The New York-based prediction market company has joined BetMGM and DraftKings with its logo along the walls of Fenway Park.

articles.title: Game 132: Red Sox at Marlins lineups and notes
articles.description: Payton Tolle will be on the mound in Miami when the Red Sox look to extend their winning streak to five.

articles.title: How did the Red Sox offense improve from one of the worst in baseball to one of the best?
articles.description: Through Sunday, the club’s average of 6.0 runs per game in August led baseball.

articles.title: In rare start, Anthony Seigler delivers go-ahead triple in ninth inning to give Red Sox fourth straight win
articles.description: The Sox have won four straight and six of seven and are now only 2.5 games behind the Yankees for the first American League wild card.

articles.title: Garrett Whitlock could return to Red Sox bullpen as soon as this weekend’s trip to New York
articles.description: The righthander has been on the injured list since Aug. 10 with elbow inflammation, traveled to Miami with the team and is set to face hitters before Wednesday's game.

articles.title: Game 131: Red Sox at Marlins lineups and notes
articles.description: Ranger Suarez will be on the mound when the Red Sox open a three-game series at Miami.

articles.title: Adley Rutschman takes care of his pitchers, and other Red Sox thoughts
articles.description: Rutschman has picked up some habits from his father, a catcher himself.

articles.title: Nick Sogard helping to boost Red Sox’ middle infield production after team’s early-season injury problems
articles.description: Sogard, Anthony Seigler, and Andruw Monasterio have given the Red Sox depth with Trevor Story, Isiah Kiner-Falefa, and Romy Gonzalez sidelined.
